messages:
maria_cs: Heads-up — Scarab dedicated bring-up tomorrow 09:30 PT. Main goals: quota handoff, autoscale policy, 2-step load tests, and KMS key rotation. Can we confirm the exact quota numbers and any billing tags? @sam_engineering @priya_sre

sam_engineering: Confirming quota: 50k tokens/min shared across 3 reserved slots (initially 3 workers). Hardware: 3xA100-80GB reserved, burst to 6 for peak. Billing tag: account:scarab-dedicated-2026. Will push config to infra PR today.

priya_sre: SRE side — I want min_replicas=2 for safety, autoscale policy: cpu_target=60%, token_rate_window=30s, scale_cooldown=90s. We'll run a shadow canary for 20m before traffic shift. Also need KMS rotation window pinned to 10:45 PT to avoid overlap with loadtest ramp.

maria_cs: Got it. Customer asks for a dry-run of the failover mapping (if primary pool exhausted -> fallback model). Proposed fallback: gpt-neox-20b-quant (slower but cheaper). @eli_cloud_ops can you confirm compatibility?

eli_cloud_ops: fallback looks good. I already tested model variant compatibility for endpoints. Added a routing rule: scarab-prod -> scarab-fallback with priority 0. Fallback latency ~350ms higher; documented in runbook.

sam_engineering: I pushed the routing + cache warmup hooks in infra PR #4821. Also added a startup warmup job to prepopulate KV cache:
```
# warmup job example
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/warmup -H 'Authorization: Bearer $RW_KEY' -d '{"model":"scarab-primary","prefixes":["Hello","Order status","/api/lookup"]}'
```
Schedule: warmup job runs at T-15 and T-5 before traffic shift.

ops_bot: Reservation: loadtest-scarab-177777 (10:00-11:30 UTC). Resource lock applied to pool scarab-prod. Incident channel: #eng-oncall reserved for the window. :calendar:

jordan_re: Shared onboarding doc with Scarab PM (link: https://docs.internal/redwood/scarab-onboard). It includes runbook, escalation matrix, and customer SLAs. Customer wants a quick walkthrough at +30m after canary completes.

maria_cs: Plan for tomorrow: 09:30 — brief sync, 09:40 — KV warmup, 09:50 — shadow canary (20m), 10:15 — ramp to 50% traffic (observability check), 10:30 — full loadtest to validate autoscale, 10:45 — KMS rotate (if green), 11:15 — postmortem notes. Please call out any blockers now.

priya_sre: Blocker: need confirmation that we won't run any infra deploys to the serving fleet between 09:00-12:00 PT. Please ping release team.

sam_engineering: No deploys during the window from infra side, noted. I'll also attach the loadtest script and traffic profile for visibility.

maria_cs: Thanks — one more ask from Scarab: capture latency P95 and tail error counts for the first 48h. Can we wire that into console dashboards? @sam_engineering @priya_sre

eli_cloud_ops: Dashboard tile created under Scarab > Health > Latency+Errors. We'll also export CSV for the CS team daily.

maria_cs: Excellent. Closing thread unless new blockers. I'll do the customer prep email at EOD. :white_check_mark:
